snell_assumption: fixed incident wedge angle, constant wedge speed; steel Vs changes with temperature; no curved-ray, weld anisotropy or mode-conversion amplitude physics
inference_inputs: nominal wall and nominal probe profile, measured temperature only; no true geometry
paired_correction: thermal source tested with fixed nominal angle and measured-temperature Snell angle, both predeclared; no recalibration
thickness_scope: GT known ID-corner-positive evaluation cohort only; detector misses count tolerance misses; normals are no-path
stopping_rule: diagnostic only, no tuning or release selection from these outcomes
